QuestInfo.name: Maya of Henesys
QuestInfo.0: You hear that #p1012101# is very sick...
QuestInfo.1: A girl named Maya in Henesys has been ill for a long time. It looks like she can't live a normal life at all. You agree to help her. #bWeird Medicine#k... What a strange name! She says she'll get a little better by taking that... You should go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo...
QuestInfo.2: Maya wanted you to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so you did just that. He promised to give you the Weird Medicine only after you get him a Sparkling Rock. Geez, he won't even give any free medicine for a sick girl?

0.0: Cough...cough... Oh, hello stranger. Sorry, but may I ask you for a favor? I've been sick for a while, and the doctors can't do anything. Lately, it has gotten so bad I can't even take care of myself.
0.1: Is there any way you can get me some #b#t4031006##k? I am not sure exactly how to get that, but #r#p1002001##k from #b#m104000000##k may know a thing or two about it. Please help me. Cough, cough... Pardon me.

npc.0: You haven't met up with #r#p1002001##k, yet? #p1002001# from #b#m104000000##k can definitely help you find some #p1002001#. Please... Talk to him for me...
